request.instruction: Create a refined decorative background with at least three concentric circular orbit tracks around an open central area. Each orbit must have a clearly different radius and angular speed, and at least one orbit must rotate in the opposite direction. Put small geometric satellites and symbols (circles, diamonds, plus signs or star-like polygons) on every orbit, with fine rings and a few subtle radial markers. Keep the lower central area visually calm for a separate native title. Use a dark navy field with cyan, violet and warm coral accents. Expose meaningful scalar parameters including exactly speed_multiplier, orbit_scale and accent_color, and make the program actually read them. The motion must be continuous and deterministic.

returned_direction.name: Counterpoint Orbits
returned_direction.title: Ideas in motion
returned_direction.intent: A refined counter-rotating orbital field with an open center and a quiet lower area for the native title.
returned_direction.visual_description: Fine cyan, violet, and coral rings surround a dark open center. Circles, diamonds, plus signs, stars, and rings orbit each track at distinct speeds; the middle counter-rotates. Turning outer ticks add depth. The native title sits below.
